gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-sq: Wide and brash: Goldman spreads its round letters out with room to spare. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square keeps paragraphs friendly and crisp, its wide gaps and soaring x-height holding up at tiny sizes.
gen-flavors-gf-ruda: Ruda draws a wire-like monoline sans with wide-mouthed rounds, tucked beneath Flavors and its stubby, towering lowercase. The real draw is playful whimsy up top meeting screen-ready clarity below.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-numans: Wide and commanding, Goldman takes up space with round forms. Where Goldman excels at announcing, Numans, with its loosely tracked, tightly coiled lowercase, excels at carrying the text that follows.
gen-eater-gf-sofia-sans: Eater is dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between letters and a gentle thick-thin rhythm. But Sofia Sans runs a single pen-like line with open rounds, so paragraphs move along smoothly and stay legible.
gen-flavors-gf-sen: Tall, modern lowercase traced in one constant line gives the body its voice. Sen is best at carrying text, while Flavors, with its sturdy diagonals and towering lowercase, is best at making a whimsical, commanding statement.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws every round letter with a clear channel in and no shift in line weight. Schibsted Grotesk brings open, tall-bowled letters below, and that loud-meets-friendly gap is the real draw.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sintony: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like, same-width strokes, like a marker tip. Sintony takes over below with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, so reading flows without friction.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-onest: Onest keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, with a gentle monotone line that feels drawn with ruler and compass. But Goldman makes the statement with wide-set round forms, while Onest simply carries the words.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Futuristic and techy, Audiowide draws tile-like letters with no thick-thin shift, while Noto Sans Tai Viet adds a tall x-height. Give the heading generous size and let the body stay modest.
gen-eater-gf-stack-sans-headline: Crisp at tiny sizes and approachable, the body runs a ballpoint-like line through a deep middle band. Stack Sans Headline keeps text moving smoothly, a steady counterweight to the gentle pencil-soft shifts of Eater.
